faq.q: What is the typical application for titanium hydrogen flame arrestor?
faq.a: Titanium Hydrogen Flame Arrestor is designed for sintered titanium flame arrestor micro-porous disc. The Grade 2 CP-Ti grade is selected to provide the optimal balance of strength, fatigue life, and environmental resistance for this specific application.
